programs.title: Melodies Of The Heart
programs.desc: A determined mother refuses to bow to the rigid expectations and barriers imposed by society, choosing instead to carve out a path where her daughter's dreams can take flight. Parth Samthaan, Rishita Kothari.

programs.title: Love By Force
programs.desc: Naitik and Akshara are forced to marry, while love brings Kartik and Naira together, revealing the difference between love-based relationships and forced marriage. Hina Khan, Karan Mehra.

programs.title: Secret Superstar
programs.desc: Insia is a very talented singer, but unluckily her father doesn't want to let her practice her talent, so her mother secretly encourages her until she gets her dreams. Zaira Wasim, Aamir Khan, Meher Vij, Raj Arjun, Farrukh Jaffar, Advait Chandan, Advait Chandan.

programs.title: Ek Main Aurr Ek Tu
programs.desc: Rahul meets with Riana in her most desperate moments after she broke up with her boyfriend. They drink a lot and the next day when they wake they discover that they got married. But they fall in love with each others. Kareena Kapoor, Imran Khan, Boman Irani, Shakun Batra, Shakun Batra, Ayesha DeVitre.

programs.title: The Bitter Harvest
programs.desc: Zeba is forced to question everything when the man she depends on begins to change in unexpected ways. Caught between family pressure and emotional detachment, she struggles to hold her life together. Sanam Saeed, Emmad Irfani.

programs.title: Mannat
programs.desc: Drama Mannat, a gifted chef, works under a boss who is unknowingly her biological mother, and as her dreams for the future collide with the hidden truths of her past, fate begins to reorder her life. Mukta Dhond.
